sentences.text:
Order 
This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 482 of BNSS, 2023 for grant of anticipatory bail relating to Crime No.328/2025, registered at Police Station - Sanjeevani Nagar,
District - Jabalpur (M.P.) for commission of offences under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B of IPC.
The Applicant is apprehending his arrest has approached this Court for grant of anticipatory bail.

2. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant himself is victim of the transaction, as some body who is later identified as Satyendra Kumar Upadhyay has represented himself to be Amar Singh Thakur by preparing the frivolous Aadhar Card, and thereafter the applicant NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:63206 2 MCRC-42393-2025 has entered into the transaction of the open plot, which is shown of the ownership of the said Amar Singh Thakur.
Accordingly, the applicant has paid the amount and purchased the plot in question.

He has further submitted that even the plan for construction is also approved by the Municipal Authority on the open plot and, therefore, he has not played any active part in commission of the offence as alleged in the FIR nor any criminality can be attributed to the present applicant.

Therefore, he prays that the applicant be released on anticipatory bail by exercising the power under Section 482 of BNSS.
3 .

Per contra, learned counsel for the complainant has strongly opposed the said request by Sandeep Shrivastava vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12109038/

sentences.text: 1 referring to the return filed in the present application has submitted that all the persons are projecting them as owner of the property of Shri Amar Singh Thakur the complainant himself and actually the complainant is residing on the premises in question which is sought to be sold by such fabricated document and applicant has constructed the house on the property in question.

When the complainant has approached the revenue authority regarding some mutation, it came to his knowledge that such fraudulent transaction has taken place whereby the present applicant and other accused persons have played active role.
The participation of present applicant is established from the fact that he entered into the transaction and amount is also paid by him.

He has further submitted that this is a case of impersonation, as complainant has never entered into such transaction and somebody else has projected himself as Amar Singh and the present applicant has also supported him.

He further submitted that the NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:63206 3 MCRC-42393-2025 applicant is not cooperating in the investigation and avoiding the arrest, therefore, no discretion should be exercised in favour of the applicant.

4. Counsel for the State has also opposed the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail and contended that such organized crime committed by the persons with a view to dupe the property of the citizen can be certainly considered as an offence against such society and unless the accused person cooperated in the process of investigation by making themselves available for further investigation, the relief which is sought by way of present application is not required to be granted, as there is sufficient material available which indicates the involvement of present applicant.
5.

I have considered the rival submissions made at the Bar and considered the fact that applicant has not made available in the process of investigation, though the FIR is filed on 30.08.2025, and somehow evading the arrest.

More over, on bare reading of FIR, the involvement of the present applicant in transaction is undisputed, as he has entered into the transaction for the said property with the said so called Amar Singh.

Whether the applicant can be prima facie responsible in committing such offence by duping the valuable property of the complainant can be ascertained after further investigation and proper cooperation of the applicant.

Prima facie, it also transpires that the case of impersonation in the name of Amar Singh is also coming on record, as one Satyendra Kumar Upadhyay, who as per the Investigating Officer is also accomplice of the present applicant.

6. Considering all these aspects and the nature of allegation and considering the case diary, the material available on record, prima facie NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:63206 4 MCRC-42393-2025 offence is made out and requires further interrogation and investigation of all the accused persons named in the FIR.

I have also considered the impact of such incident on the larger interest of the society and, therefore also, I am not inclined to grant any relief in favour of the present applicant, whereby his prima facie role is pointed out by the Investigation Agency, which requires further investigation, therefore, the present application for grant of anticipatory bail is dismissed.

(SANDEEP N. BHATT) JUDGE b Sandeep Shrivastava vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12109038/
